userSpecifiedSources: Pitch-by-pitch rows: Baseball Savant Statcast search (MLB Advanced Media), https://baseballsavant.mlb.com/statcast_search , one CSV per player, season and role, regular season only. Player list, names, bio and season stats: MLB StatsAPI, https://statsapi.mlb.com (/sports/1/players, /people, season and sabermetrics stats). Built by build.py in https://github.com/yasumorishima/kaggle-datasets (japanese-mlb-players-statcast), which fails without writing anything unless every gate in the dataset description passes.

japanese_mlb_pitching.csv.description: Every regular-season pitch thrown in MLB from 2015 to 2026 by the pitchers in players.csv (Japan-born players; Shohei Ohtani is in both pitch files). One row per pitch, exactly as Baseball Savant's Statcast search serves it (all of Savant's columns, values unchanged), plus player_name_eng (the full name from MLB StatsAPI). The pitcher column is always the Japanese player; join it to players.csv or season_summary.csv on mlbam_id. Regular season only (game_type R). Every player-season was checked against MLB StatsAPI: id, name, season, game type, and a pitch count equal to StatsAPI's (Savant's automatic_ball / automatic_strike rows, which are not pitches, excluded).

columns.pitch_type: Pitch type code as classified by Statcast (FF four-seam, SI sinker, FC cutter, SL slider, ST sweeper, CU curveball, CH changeup, FS splitter, ...).
columns.release_speed: Pitch velocity at release point in miles per hour (mph)
columns.release_pos_x: Horizontal release point in feet (catcher's perspective: negative=left, positive=right)
columns.release_pos_z: Vertical release point in feet (height above ground)
columns.player_name: The pitcher's name as Baseball Savant writes it ('Last, First'). The build checks it against MLB StatsAPI's name for the pitcher id.
columns.player_name_eng: Added by this dataset (not a Statcast column): the pitcher's full name from MLB StatsAPI ('First Last').
columns.batter: MLBAM id of the batter facing the pitch.
columns.pitcher: MLBAM id of the pitcher: the Japanese player of the row. Joins to mlbam_id in players.csv and season_summary.csv (role pitcher).
columns.events: Plate-appearance outcome (e.g. single, strikeout, home_run, walk); filled only on the last pitch of a plate appearance.
columns.description: Individual pitch result (ball, called_strike, swinging_strike, hit_into_play, foul, etc.)
columns.spin_dir: Deprecated Savant column, kept so the files have Savant's full schema; empty in every row (the build fails otherwise).
columns.spin_rate_deprecated: Deprecated Savant column, kept so the files have Savant's full schema; empty in every row (the build fails otherwise).
columns.break_angle_deprecated: Deprecated Savant column, kept so the files have Savant's full schema; empty in every row (the build fails otherwise).
columns.break_length_deprecated: Deprecated Savant column, kept so the files have Savant's full schema; empty in every row (the build fails otherwise).
columns.zone: Strike zone location (1-9=strike zone grid, 11-14=outside zone)
columns.des: Detailed text description of the play
columns.game_type: Game type. Always R (regular season) in this dataset; spring training and postseason pitches are not included.
columns.type: Pitch outcome category (S=strike, B=ball, X=in play)
columns.hit_location: Fielder position number where ball was hit (1=pitcher, 2=catcher, 3=1B, etc.)
columns.bb_type: Batted ball type (ground_ball, line_drive, fly_ball, popup)
columns.balls: Number of balls in the count (0-3)
columns.strikes: Number of strikes in the count (0-2)
columns.pfx_x: Horizontal movement in feet from the catcher's perspective, without gravity (Statcast's induced movement).
columns.pfx_z: Vertical movement in feet without gravity (induced vertical break): positive = the pitch stays above the path of a spinless pitch.
columns.plate_x: Horizontal position at home plate in feet (catcher's perspective: negative=left, positive=right)
columns.plate_z: Vertical position at home plate in feet (height above ground)
columns.on_3b: MLBAM player ID of runner on 3rd base (NaN if empty)
columns.on_2b: MLBAM player ID of runner on 2nd base (NaN if empty)
columns.on_1b: MLBAM player ID of runner on 1st base (NaN if empty)
columns.outs_when_up: Number of outs when batter came to plate (0-2)
columns.hc_x: Hit coordinate X position (pixel coordinates on field diagram)
columns.hc_y: Hit coordinate Y position (pixel coordinates on field diagram)
columns.tfs_deprecated: Deprecated Savant column, kept so the files have Savant's full schema; empty in every row (the build fails otherwise).
columns.tfs_zulu_deprecated: Deprecated Savant column, kept so the files have Savant's full schema; empty in every row (the build fails otherwise).
columns.umpire: Deprecated Savant column, kept so the files have Savant's full schema; empty in every row (the build fails otherwise).
columns.sv_id: Savant's old pitch id (YYMMDD_hhmmss); filled in 2015-2016 only in this dataset.
columns.vx0: Initial velocity in X direction (feet per second) at y=50 feet
columns.vy0: Initial velocity in Y direction (feet per second) at y=50 feet
columns.vz0: Initial velocity in Z direction (feet per second) at y=50 feet
columns.ax: Acceleration in X direction (feet per second squared)
columns.ay: Acceleration in Y direction (feet per second squared)
columns.az: Acceleration in Z direction (feet per second squared)
columns.sz_top: Top of batter's strike zone in feet (varies by batter height)
columns.sz_bot: Bottom of batter's strike zone in feet (varies by batter height)
columns.hit_distance_sc: Projected hit distance in feet (Statcast calculation)
columns.launch_speed: Exit velocity off the bat in miles per hour (mph)

columns.effective_speed: Perceived velocity adjusted for release point extension (mph)

columns.release_extension: Release point extension toward home plate in feet (distance from rubber)
columns.game_pk: Unique game identifier in MLB's database

columns.fielder_7: MLBAM player ID of left fielder
columns.fielder_8: MLBAM player ID of center fielder
columns.fielder_9: MLBAM player ID of right fielder
columns.release_pos_y: Distance from home plate at release point in feet
columns.estimated_ba_using_speedangle: Expected batting average based on launch speed/angle (xBA)
columns.estimated_woba_using_speedangle: Expected weighted on-base average based on launch speed/angle (xwOBA)
columns.woba_value: wOBA value assigned to this outcome
columns.woba_denom: wOBA denominator (1 if counted, 0 if excluded)
columns.babip_value: BABIP value Statcast assigns to the plate-appearance outcome (1 = hit on a ball in play other than a home run).
columns.iso_value: Isolated-power value of the outcome (extra bases: 1 double, 2 triple, 3 home run; 0 otherwise).
columns.launch_speed_angle: Statcast launch speed/angle category of a batted ball: 1 Weak, 2 Topped, 3 Under, 4 Flare/Burner, 5 Solid Contact, 6 Barrel.
columns.at_bat_number: At-bat sequence number within the game
columns.pitch_number: Pitch sequence number within the at-bat
columns.home_score: Home team score before this pitch
columns.away_score: Away team score before this pitch
columns.bat_score: Batting team score before this pitch
columns.fld_score: Fielding team score before this pitch

columns.post_bat_score: Batting team score after this pitch

columns.of_fielding_alignment: Outfield defensive alignment (Standard, Strategic, Shift, etc.)
columns.spin_axis: Spin axis orientation in degrees (0-360, with 180=pure backspin, 0=pure topspin)
columns.delta_home_win_exp: Change in home team win expectancy from this pitch
columns.delta_run_exp: Change in run expectancy from this pitch
columns.bat_speed: Bat speed in mph from Statcast bat tracking; empty on pitches without a tracked swing and before 2023 (Statcast bat tracking).
columns.swing_length: Swing length in feet from Statcast bat tracking; empty on pitches without a tracked swing and before 2023 (Statcast bat tracking).
columns.miss_distance: Statcast's miss distance on a swinging strike (how far the bat missed the ball); empty on other pitches and before 2023. Savant does not state the unit.
columns.estimated_slg_using_speedangle: Expected slugging percentage based on launch speed/angle (xSLG)
columns.delta_pitcher_run_exp: Change in run expectancy attributed to pitcher
columns.hyper_speed: Statcast's hyper speed: launch_speed with a floor of 88 mph (launch_speed at 88 and above, 88 below). Where launch_speed is empty it is empty or 88 (some foul bunts), except 6 pitches without contact in 2015-2017 that carry a stray value from Savant.
columns.home_score_diff: Home team score differential (home minus away)
columns.home_win_exp: Home team win expectancy before this pitch (0-1)
columns.bat_win_exp: Batting team win expectancy before this pitch (0-1)
columns.age_pit_legacy: Savant's earlier pitcher age field (see age_pit).
columns.age_bat_legacy: Savant's earlier batter age field (see age_bat).
columns.age_pit: Pitcher's age as Savant gives it now. age_pit_legacy is Savant's earlier age field; the two can differ by one year.
columns.age_bat: Batter's age as Savant gives it now. age_bat_legacy is Savant's earlier age field; the two can differ by one year.
columns.n_thruorder_pitcher: Times pitcher has faced the batting order this game
columns.n_priorpa_thisgame_player_at_bat: Number of prior plate appearances by this batter in this game
columns.pitcher_days_since_prev_game: Days since pitcher's previous game appearance
columns.batter_days_since_prev_game: Days since batter's previous game appearance
columns.pitcher_days_until_next_game: Days until pitcher's next game appearance
columns.batter_days_until_next_game: Days until batter's next game appearance
columns.api_break_z_with_gravity: Vertical break including gravity, in feet; positive = downward.
columns.api_break_x_arm: Horizontal break in feet toward the pitcher's arm side (positive = arm side).
columns.api_break_x_batter_in: Horizontal break in feet toward the batter (positive = in on the batter).
columns.arm_angle: Pitcher's arm angle at release in degrees (Savant); mostly filled from 2020 in this dataset, empty in 2015-2019.
columns.attack_angle: Bat's vertical attack angle at contact in degrees (Statcast bat tracking); empty on pitches without a tracked swing and before 2023 (Statcast bat tracking).
columns.attack_direction: Bat's horizontal attack direction in degrees (Statcast bat tracking); empty on pitches without a tracked swing and before 2023 (Statcast bat tracking).
columns.swing_path_tilt: Tilt of the swing plane in degrees (Statcast bat tracking); empty on pitches without a tracked swing and before 2023 (Statcast bat tracking).
columns.intercept_ball_minus_batter_pos_x_inches: Statcast bat tracking: horizontal distance in inches between where bat meets ball and the batter's position; empty on pitches without a tracked swing and before 2023 (Statcast bat tracking).
columns.intercept_ball_minus_batter_pos_y_inches: Statcast bat tracking: depth distance in inches between where bat meets ball and the batter's position; empty on pitches without a tracked swing and before 2023 (Statcast bat tracking).

players.csv.description: One row per player: every player born in Japan (MLB StatsAPI birthCountry) with an MLB regular-season game from 2015 to 2026, plus two US-born players of Japanese heritage kept from the earlier version. MLBAM id, name, birth country, city and date, position, bats/throws, debut date, MLB teams and the seasons with rows in each pitch file. in_previous_version and previous_wrong_id record what changed from the earlier (February 2026) version, which had wrong ids for Hisashi Iwakuma and Yuki Matsui. The earlier npb_team and note columns were hand-typed and are not included.

columns.mlbam_id: MLB Advanced Media player id. Joins to pitcher / batter in the pitch files and to season_summary.csv.
columns.name: Full name from MLB StatsAPI.
columns.name_last_first: 'Last, First' from MLB StatsAPI (the form of Savant's player_name).
columns.birth_country: Birth country from MLB StatsAPI: Japan, except the two players with a heritage_note.
columns.heritage_note: 'US-born, Japanese heritage' for Lars Nootbaar and Gosuke Katoh, kept from the earlier version by an explicit list; empty otherwise.
columns.primary_position: Primary position from MLB StatsAPI at build time (P, TWP = two-way player, C, 1B, 2B, 3B, SS, LF, CF, RF, DH).
columns.bats: Batting side from MLB StatsAPI: L, R or S.
columns.throws: Throwing hand from MLB StatsAPI: L or R.
columns.mlb_debut_date: MLB debut date from MLB StatsAPI (YYYY-MM-DD); may be before 2015.
columns.roles: Which pitch files have rows for the player: pitcher, batter, or both.
columns.teams: MLB teams the player appeared for in the seasons covered (StatsAPI abbreviation of that season), by season (within a season in StatsAPI's order), separated by /.
columns.seasons: Comma-separated seasons 2015-2026 with MLB regular-season games.
columns.pitching_seasons: Seasons with rows in japanese_mlb_pitching.csv (pitches thrown in the regular season).
columns.batting_seasons: Seasons with rows in japanese_mlb_batting.csv (plate appearances in the regular season, pitchers included).
columns.in_previous_version: yes if the player was in the earlier (February 2026) version of this dataset, including the two whose id was wrong there; no if new.
columns.previous_wrong_id: Hisashi Iwakuma and Yuki Matsui only: the wrong id the earlier version used (461325 is Tyler Clippard, 680686 is Josiah Gray). Empty otherwise.

season_summary.csv.description: One row per player, season and role (pitcher or batter): MLB StatsAPI regular-season stats (games, pitches, plate appearances or innings, rate stats) and MLB StatsAPI sabermetrics (wOBA, wRC+, FIP, xFIP, WAR; MLB's own calculation, not FanGraphs'), next to statcast_rows, the number of rows of the same player-season-role in the pitch file. Useful to filter the pitch files by workload or to join season outcomes to pitch-level features.

columns.mlbam_id: MLB Advanced Media player id (joins to players.csv and the pitch files).
columns.name: Full name from MLB StatsAPI.
columns.role: pitcher (a row of japanese_mlb_pitching.csv) or batter (japanese_mlb_batting.csv). Two-way seasons have one row per role.
columns.teams: MLB teams in the season (StatsAPI abbreviations), in StatsAPI's order, separated by /.
columns.games: MLB StatsAPI regular-season games played (pitching games for role pitcher, batting games for role batter).
columns.statsapi_pitches: MLB StatsAPI regular-season pitches thrown (pitcher) or seen (batter).
